data.name: Helluva Heist
data.detailed_description:
Fellow Gamers,

We designed Helluva Heist to be a laughter-filled adventure that embraces the fun, the frustrating, the chaotic, and the purely ridiculous moments of gaming with friends. If you’re looking for a non-stop dopamine rush of hilarious sabotage, this is the game for you.

For the optimal experience, we highly recommend playing with at least 3 other friends. For the best experience: heists with 6+ players escalate quickly into full-blown, beautiful mayhem.

Experience an intense, chaotic, adrenaline-pumping bank heist.

As a Robber:

  • Join a high-stakes group heist with your friends.

  • Steal over $15M in cash from the vault/safes.

  • Crush rival robber teams standing in your way.

  • Survive intense shootouts with the Police.

  • Don’t let the Disruptors spoil your plan.

  • Adapt to random, unknown events that change the game.

  • Extract the loot to claim your victory.

As a Disruptor:

  • Sabotage the heist in your own way, be a silent shadow or a loud menace.

  • Choose to either support or destroy the robber teams for your own gain.

  • Turn a tactical operation into total mayhem.

  • No rules, no limits, just play it your way.

We are planning to add more features after the Early Access:

  • Get skins (characters, guns), new characters with your Heist Coin.

  • New maps, events for more fun.

  • And other features according to your suggestions.

data.short_description: Your friends are bagging over $15M in cash, but you’re here to ruin the score. Sabotage their heist at any cost while surviving lethal random events.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5500
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Required. Targeted 60 FPS at 1080p, Low/Medium Settings.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700H / AMD Ryzen 7 7435HS
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / RTX 4060 Laptop
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Required (NVMe recommended). Targeted 60 FPS at 1080p, High Settings.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game includes action-oriented violence and criminal themes.
Players participate in fast-paced combat situations involving firearms and heist-style missions such as stealing money, valuables, or information.
The game does not contain sexual acts or sexual content.
All violent elements are fictional and presented purely for gameplay purposes.
